why: Minecraft yaw a means direction (dx, dz) = (-sin a, cos a): -145.0 points north-east. Intersect the two lines (x1 - t sin a1, z1 + t cos a1) and (x2 - s sin a2, z2 + s cos a2). The intersection is (1504.3, -2112.5), 564.2 blocks from throw 1 and 2593.4 blocks from (0, 0), inside the first ring (1,280-2,816), so it is plausible. Reading each yaw to 0.1 degrees moves the answer by at most 6.1 blocks; 16 blocks (one chunk) is the tolerance.
trap: Using yaw as a math angle from +X (1186.1, -1646.5), mixing up the sign so the point is south-west, or skipping the math and following eyes one throw at a time.

techniques.description: Intersect two eye throws instead of following eyes.

sources: https://minecraft.wiki/w/Rotation (raw line 16: yaw -180 north, -90 east, 0 south, 90 west)
https://minecraft.wiki/w/Tutorial:Defeating_the_ender_dragon (Triangulation section, raw lines 117-124; eyes point to the staircase chunk's NW corner, raw line 133)

alternates.why_valid: Answers with the staircase position (chunk offset 4, 4), which is where a runner digs; 5.7 blocks from the intersection.

broken.why_wrong: Math-angle convention instead of Minecraft yaw.
